chapter: Erroll Garner, the 1952 arrest and Florida
title: Years with Garner and Martha Glaser's role in his exit
summary: He was with Garner from late 1949 to 1952; manager Martha Glaser wanted him gone.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Back to '49, you worked with Erroll part of the time. What else did you do in 1949? You weren't with Erroll all of the time were you?

Well, as soon as he came back from Paris, I was from Erroll from '49, the latter part of '49 -- I think it was the latter part of '49. In fact, I'm almost sure it was the latter part of '49. Then '49, '50, '51, '52. And then I got arrested, and he was told not to come near me. It would do something to his drawing attraction, you know.
Yes. No relation to Joe Glager.
Yeah. She wanted me out of the way because I was telling Erroll the ways of the agencies, you know, and what they would do and whatnot. So with me out of the way,
